name: yt-dlp Downloader
description: Generic yt-dlp-powered video and audio downloads.
author: Cove Team

externalDependencies.name: yt-dlp
externalDependencies.description: Command line downloader used for generic video and audio sites.

settings.name: ytDlpPath
settings.description: Path to yt-dlp, or yt-dlp when it is available on PATH.

settings.name: siteRequestIntervalSeconds
settings.displayName: Seconds between requests to a site you sign in to
settings.description: Minimum seconds between starting requests to a site with a saved login. Defaults to 0.15; raise it if a site rate-limits a large batch.
